ijonis-geo-lint-content-creator.description: Self-configuring content creation pipeline with geo-lint validation. On first use, scans your project to learn its framework, content schema, categories, and authors, then creates SEO & GEO-optimized content matched to your brand voice. Validates every piece with geo-lint's 92 rules until zero violations. Triggers on: "content-creator", "create content", "write blog", "new post", "content calendar", "brand voice", "content strategy".
ijonis-geo-lint-content-creator.author: Alireza Rezvani
ijonis-geo-lint-content-creator.tools: Bash(npx geo-lint*), Bash(npm *), Bash(node *), Bash(python *brand_voice*), Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, WebSearch, AskUserQuestion, Agent

ijonis-geo-lint-geo-lint.description: SEO & GEO content linter — validates Markdown/MDX files for AI search visibility using 92 deterministic rules (35 GEO, 32 SEO, 14 content quality, 8 technical, 3 i18n). Runs an autonomous lint-fix loop: scan content, read structured violations, fix them, re-lint until clean. Use when optimizing content for AI citations, auditing SEO compliance, checking GEO readiness, or running pre-publish content validation. Triggers on: "geo-lint", "lint content", "SEO audit", "GEO", "content optimization", "AI search", "citation readiness".
ijonis-geo-lint-geo-lint.tools: Bash(npx geo-lint*), Bash(npm *), Bash(node *), Bash(grep *), Bash(find *), Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob
